name: Turn Google Maps results or a domain list into verified, enriched sales leads in Google Sheets (Apify)

nodes.name: Write the Ready to send tab

parameters.content:
## Google Maps leads to verified, enriched sales leads

**Who it's for:** sales and agency teams who prospect local businesses from Google Maps (or a list of company websites) and need a lead list they can segment and import without bouncing.

### How it works
1. Takes the websites from a **Google Maps scraper run** (its dataset ID) or a **sheet of domains**.
2. **Google Maps Email Extractor** (tidytools/website-contact-extractor) reads each business's own website (robots.txt respected) and returns its emails. Only websites with an email are charged. If no website has an email, the run stops there.
3. **Bulk Email Validator** (tidytools/bulk-email-validator) checks every address: syntax, MX records, disposable, role, typos. No mail server is contacted.
4. **Lead & Company Enrichment** (tidytools/company-website-enrichment) adds what the company does, industry, B2B/B2C, employees when stated, and company social profiles; one charge per company.
5. Writes a ranked **Ready to send** tab (deliverable, risky, undeliverable) with business name, website and place ID.

### Setup
1. Add your Apify credential to the three Apify nodes and your Google credential to both Sheets nodes.
2. In **Lead list settings**, paste a Google Maps run's dataset ID into `mapsDatasetId` (then disable **Read the domain sheet**), or set your website column and pick the domain sheet.
3. Add a `Ready to send` tab with the header `Email`, `Send priority`, `Send status`, `Business`, `Website`, `Place ID`, `Source row`, `Best email of the business`, `Score`, `Role address`, `What the company does`, `Industry`, `B2B or B2C`, `Employees`, `Country`, `Phone`, `LinkedIn`, `Facebook`, `Instagram`, `Company data note`, `Checked at` and pick it in the last node.
4. Click **Execute workflow**.

### Cost
$2 per 1,000 websites with an email, $0.50 per 1,000 addresses, $6 per 1,000 companies (Apify pay-per-event, Oct 2026). Our 20-website test: about $0.17. Caps: $1, $0.50, $1.

## 1. Websites to read
A Google Maps run's dataset ID, or the website column of your sheet (up to `maxRowsPerRun`).

## 2. Find, verify and enrich
The extractor's dataset goes into the validator, the validator's into the enrichment. Set `emailsToCheck` to `bestEmail` to check one address per business.

## 3. Ready to send
Ranked rows, matched on `Email`, so re-runs update instead of duplicating.

### What "deliverable" means
The domain accepts mail and nothing looks wrong. Mailboxes are not probed, so some addresses can still bounce. Follow anti-spam and data-protection rules when you send.
